bio: Bartender in a neon Miami 80s bar. Stirred, shaken, never rushed. Adults only.
avatar: Portrait of a charming bartender in his mid 30s with a groomed beard and rolled-up sleeves behind a neon bar in pink and teal light, smile, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person, clearly an adult
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a retro neon bar in a neon Miami 80s style with pink and teal tube lights and palm-leaf wallpaper, a copper shaker in the middle band, cinematic

videos.title: Neon Miami 80s, last call
videos.description: A retro-crime bar in pink and teal neon, a shaker and a rainy window.
videos.still: Wide cinematic photograph of a retro bar in a neon Miami 80s aesthetic with pink and teal neon tubes, palm motifs, a bartender shaking a cocktail in silhouette and rain on the window, no text, no logos, fictional adults clearly over 25, tasteful, energetic, cinematic
videos.motion: The bartender shakes and pours, neon tubes buzz and flicker, rain streaks the window, camera glides along the bar.

videos.title: Old fashioned, stirred slow
videos.description: Ice, bitters and a spiral of orange peel.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a bartender's hand stirring an amber old fashioned in a mixing glass with a long bar spoon, neon pink bar lights, no face, no text
videos.motion: The spoon stirs slowly and ice clinks, an orange peel twists and its oil mists in the light.

videos.title: Flame on the orange peel
videos.description: A flare of citrus oil over a glass.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a hand squeezing an orange peel over a lit match making a small flare above a cocktail glass, dark bar with teal neon behind, no face, no text
videos.motion: The peel is squeezed and a small flare lights the glass, sparks fade, subtle macro drift.

videos.title: Palm trees and a white convertible
videos.description: A night drive down an ocean boulevard under pink neon.
videos.still: Wide cinematic photograph of a white vintage convertible driving down an ocean boulevard at night in a neon Miami 80s style, pink and teal neon signs without readable text, palm trees, wet road reflections, no people visible, no logos
videos.motion: The convertible drives past, neon reflections slide across the wet road, palm trees sway, camera tracks alongside.
